notes: Change a schedule on a long-tail trigger agent: it fires nightly but the user last talked to it 40 days ago, so `recency` (sorted by user activity) won't show it. Message avoids 'digest'/'nightly' to force paraphrase matching. Lookalikes: another scheduled summary (weekly recruiting), another evening trigger (8pm log-hours reminder, the hard one: 'evening' + '8' both match it), and a one-off 'summary' email to Bob. A wrong create makes a second trigger: duplicate nightly summaries. Reusing the log-hours agent would move the wrong reminder.
